statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, r equals the least integer k >= 0 for which there is a sequence of indices x_0, x_1, ..., x_k such that 0 <= x_t < n for every t, x_0 = 0, x_k = n - 1, and for every t with 1 <= t <= k, either |x_t - x_{t-1}| = 1 or (x_t != x_{t-1} and arr[x_t] = arr[x_{t-1}]).
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, min_jumps(arr) returns a result; that is, it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access an out-of-bounds index.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, 0 <= r <= n - 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if n = 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, r = 1 if and only if (n = 2 or (n > 1 and arr[0] = arr[n - 1])).
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, if arr[i] != arr[j] for all 0 <= i < j < n, then r = n - 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, if n > 1, then for every index k with 1 <= k < n and arr[k] = arr[0], we have r <= n - k.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, if n > 1, then for every index k with 0 <= k < n - 1 and arr[k] = arr[n - 1], we have r <= k + 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Let rev(arr) be the slice of length n with rev(arr)[i] = arr[n - 1 - i] for every 0 <= i < n. Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r and min_jumps(rev(arr)) returns a result s, we have r = s.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: For any two slices arr and brr of the same length n satisfying the preconditions, if for all 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, arr[i] = arr[j] if and only if brr[i] = brr[j], then whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r and min_jumps(brr) returns a result s, we have r = s.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr) = len(brr). Both arr and brr satisfy 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= each entry <= 10^8.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, there exists a sequence of indices x_0, x_1, ..., x_r such that 0 <= x_t < n for every t, x_0 = 0, x_r = n - 1, and for every t with 1 <= t <= r, either |x_t - x_{t-1}| = 1 or (x_t != x_{t-1} and arr[x_t] = arr[x_{t-1}]).
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_jumps(arr) returns a result r, for every integer k >= 0 and every sequence of indices y_0, y_1, ..., y_k such that 0 <= y_t < n for every t, y_0 = 0, y_k = n - 1, and for every t with 1 <= t <= k, either |y_t - y_{t-1}| = 1 or (y_t != y_{t-1} and arr[y_t] = arr[y_{t-1}]), we have k >= r.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 50000 and -10^8 <= arr[i] <= 10^8 for every 0 <= i < n.
